g.text: HAND GESTURE RECOGNITION — REAL-TIME COMPUTER VISION
Production MobileNetV3-Large + MediaPipe 3D Landmark Tracking + Vectorized Grad-CAM Explainability HUD (gui/app.py)
• High contrast hand contours on zero background
• Temporal consecutive video frames per subject
SOURCE: Grupo de Tratamiento de Imágenes (GTI)
Naive random split placed adjacent video frames into
both train and test, concealing real-world failure.
Guarantees distribution alignment with ImageNet pretraining
Leap sensor had pitch-black background; bright room pixels
around a closed hand caused Fist to misclassify as Thumb (97.9%)
Sensor hands were strictly horizontal; upright webcam thumbs
matched the vertical finger loop of the OK gesture (91.9%)
Composites synthetic room noise, wall textures & gradients
Forces model to learn finger morphology, not background contrast
Allows arbitrary hand angles and upright vertical thumbs
• Scale & Translation Jitter (±15%) • Gaussian Sensor Noise
• Enables real-time >60 FPS edge execution on consumer GPU
• Static Image Verification fallback for benchmark testing
Tracks wrist, thumb MCP/IP/tip, finger joints in 3D (x, y, z)
If no hand detected → "NO HAND DETECTED"
Halts neural forward pass; suppresses ambient hallucinations
Prevents fingertip clipping during upright thumb extension
2. Square bounding box: max_side = max(w_pad, h_pad)
3. Boundary clamping: max(0, cx - side/2), min(W, cx + side/2)
Automatic CPU fallback with zero code divergence
• Pred Conf = max(probs), Pred Label = argmax
Extracts gradients from final conv layer: features[16]
Weights channel maps by global average pooled gradients
• ReLU(Σ w_k * A_k) → Smooth colormap blend
• Confirms attention focuses on finger loop & tip
